description: This file defines the internal class ImplicitStreamSubscriberTable, which manages implicit subscribers for streams in the Orleans streaming framework. It handles cache building, subscriber identification, namespace matching, and GUID generation for subscriptions.

classes.name: ImplicitStreamSubscriberTable
classes.description: Manages implicit stream subscriptions, including cache management, namespace matching, and subscription GUID creation.

classes.name: ImplicitStreamSubscriberTable.Cache
classes.description: Holds cache data including version, namespace mappings, and predicate list for efficient lookups.

classes.name: ImplicitStreamSubscriberTable.StreamSubscriberPredicate
classes.description: Associates a stream subscriber with a namespace predicate for matching.

classes.name: ImplicitStreamSubscriberTable.StreamSubscriber
classes.description: Represents a stream subscriber tied to a specific grain and stream ID, with equality based on GrainType.

methods.name: GetCache
methods.description: Retrieves the current cache, rebuilding if bindings have changed.

methods.name: BuildCache
methods.description: Constructs a new cache from version and bindings, creating predicates for stream subscriptions.

methods.name: GetImplicitSubscribers
methods.description: Returns implicit subscribers for a namespace, using cache.

methods.name: GetOrAddImplicitSubscribers
methods.description: Fetches or computes implicit subscribers for a namespace.

methods.name: IsImplicitSubscriber
methods.description: Checks if a grain ID is an implicit subscriber for a given stream.

methods.name: TryGetImplicitSubscriptionGuid
methods.description: Attempts to get a unique subscription GUID for a grain and stream.

methods.name: MakeSubscriptionGuid
methods.description: Creates a unique GUID for a subscription based on grain type and stream ID.

methods.name: IsImplicitSubscribeEligibleNameSpace
methods.description: Determines whether a namespace is eligible for implicit subscription.

methods.name: FindImplicitSubscribers
methods.description: Finds all subscribers matching a namespace predicate.
